docs.title: HNSW 索引算法
docs.content: HNSW 全称 Hierarchical Navigable Small World，是一种基于图结构的近似最近邻搜索算法。该算法通过多层可导航小世界图组织向量数据，上层节点稀疏、下层节点稠密。检索时从最上层开始贪婪搜索，逐层下降，在底层完成细粒度近邻查找。HNSW 在召回率和查询速度之间取得了很好的平衡，被众多向量数据库采用。

docs.title: The HNSW Index Algorithm
docs.content: HNSW stands for Hierarchical Navigable Small World, an approximate nearest neighbor search algorithm based on graph structures. It organizes vector data into a multi-layer navigable small world graph, where upper layers are sparse and lower layers are dense. During search it greedily traverses from the top layer downward, finishing with fine-grained neighbor lookup at the bottom. HNSW achieves a good trade-off between recall and query speed, and is adopted by many vector databases.

docs.content: 向量数据库专门存储高维向量，并提供高效的相似度检索能力。常见的相似度度量包括欧氏距离、余弦相似度和内积。向量数据库通常为向量列建立 HNSW 或 IVF 等近似索引以加速查询。许多现代数据库将向量检索与全文检索、标量过滤结合，支持混合查询。

docs.title: Vector Databases
docs.content: Vector databases are designed to store high-dimensional vectors and provide efficient similarity search. Common similarity metrics include Euclidean distance, cosine similarity, and inner product. Vector databases usually build approximate indexes such as HNSW or IVF on vector columns to accelerate queries. Many modern databases combine vector search with full-text search and scalar filtering to support hybrid queries.

docs.title: INT8 Model Quantization
docs.content: INT8 quantization compresses model weights from 32-bit floats to 8-bit integers, greatly reducing model size. Dynamic quantization computes scale factors from activation ranges at inference time, which is simple and effective. Quantization usually introduces slight precision loss, but retrieval quality is often barely affected. Quantized models have clear advantages in memory footprint and loading speed.

docs.title: Transformer Attention Mechanism
docs.content: The attention mechanism lets the model reference other tokens in the input sequence when processing each token. Self-attention computes relevance weights between tokens through query, key, and value matrices. Multi-head attention splits the representation space into multiple subspaces to capture different dependencies in parallel. The Transformer architecture is entirely based on attention and abandons traditional recurrent structures.
